title.rendered: Nitty Gritty Dirt Band: Cadillac Ranch

content.rendered:
“Cadillac Ranch” was always rockabilly, so it shouldn’t be surprising that the Nitty Gritty Dirt Band covered it frequently in concert. They actually released live recordings of it twice, in 1984 and 1991.

Here’s the 1984 version…

…and as a bonus, here they are still performing it in 2011. Like Bruce, they’re better with age!

© February 26, 2018

excerpt.rendered: Two great live performances of “Cadillac Ranch” today–both by the Nitty Gritty Dirt Band.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Nitty Gritty Dirt Band: From Small Things (Big Things One Day Come)
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: "From Small Things" got some cover love long before Bruce officially released it. Here's one of the best. from the Nitty Gritty Dirt Band in 1990.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Warren Zevon: Cadillac Ranch
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Warren Zevon has a blast covering "Cadillac Ranch" at a beautifully captured 1982 performance.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cadillac Ranch
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Simultaneously morbid and mirthful, "Cadillac Ranch" bears surprisingly deep substance beneath its rollicking veneer.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: Pink Cadillac
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: It may be pink, but it ain’t no car. Backstory and great performances inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Bette Midler: Pink Cadillac
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Bruce cover that never was: Bette Midler recorded her version of "Pink Cadillac," but Bruce refused to let her release it. Find out why and check out her live performance of it inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Mystery Train
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The biggest mystery about "Mystery Train" (besides why it's called that): why'd it take so long for Bruce to cover it?
